contentBlocks.title: SASSA Bank Verification Process Explained — How SASSA Checks Your Account
contentBlocks.description: SASSA uses an automated system to verify your bank account before releasing grant payments. Understand how the verification works, why it might fail, and how to resolve issues to get your grant paid on time.

contentBlocks.text: SASSA uses an automated bank verification system to ensure your grant is paid into the correct account. The system checks that the ID number and name on your bank account match your SASSA application exactly. This prevents fraud and ensures payments reach the right person.

If your status has been sitting on 'Bank Verification Pending', you might be wondering what is actually happening behind the scenes. The short version: SASSA and your bank are checking that the account belongs to you. That check usually takes a matter of days, and this page explains exactly how it works and the fastest ways to pass it.

contentBlocks.title: Why this matters for your cash
contentBlocks.text: Your grant cannot be paid until the verification passes. The quicker your name, ID and account match up, the quicker your money arrives. The good news is that most failures are simple to fix — usually a name typo or an old account — not anything serious.

SASSA's automated system communicates electronically with South Africa's major banks. When you submit your bank details, the system sends a verification request to your bank asking them to confirm that the ID number and account holder name you provided match their records.

items: Name mismatch: the name on your bank account differs from your ID (e.g., 'Bob' vs 'Robert')
ID number mismatch: your ID is not correctly linked to your bank account
Account dormant or frozen: the account has not been used for an extended period
Account type not supported: some accounts (bond, credit card) cannot receive EFT
Account closed: the account is no longer active
Branch code incorrect: the code does not match the account

steps.title: Check your details on the portal
steps.description: Log into srd.sassa.gov.za and verify your account number, branch code, and account type.

steps.title: Visit your bank
steps.description: Ask your bank to confirm your ID is correctly linked to your account. Request a stamped confirmation.

steps.title: Fix name mismatches
steps.description: If your bank uses a different name format, ask them to update it to match your ID.

steps.title: Switch to Cash Send temporarily
steps.description: If you need your grant urgently, switch to Cash Send while resolving the bank issue.
